title: lem-sf-integral-adjunction-raw-localization-core

proof.text: The equality of predicates gives the proof-changing equivalence integralRepresentativeEquivalence. Transport the scalar localization along this equivalence: rationalization on the finite-Tor category is localization for the inverse image of the usual scalar denominators. Its canonical endpoint shift is exact because the full integral inclusion is exact. Its arrow functor is essentially surjective because the inclusion is an equivalence and the scalar localization has a calculus of fractions.

Define the identity-component comparison q between A.F followed by endpoint rationalization and endpoint rationalization followed by the fixed raw tensor functor. Functor.commShiftOfLocalization transports A.leftShift through this square and proves q shift compatible. Exactness reflects through the exact localization, whose arrow functor is essentially surjective.

Apply A.adjunction.localization to both literal comparison squares. Its counit component formula is exactly the localized integral counit because both comparison components are identities. Choose the right shift using rightAdjointCommShift. Its unit and counit commute with shifts, and its right adjoint is exact. The private exists_normalized_raw_core retains the counit and left shift normalization; discard those additional proof fields here to obtain the original core statement.

proof_origin.place: Constructions 6.1 and 6.2; direct localization of the supplied adjunction through the finite-Tor equivalence, with normalized comparison and canonical endpoint shifts.
